content:
BUILT CoLAB took part in the event TECH4INNOV: the Present and Future of Innovation, which took place on March 29 in Santa Maria da Feira. It was an excellent moment of networking and knowledge sharing organized by ANI – National Innovation Agency!

Throughout the day, BUILT CoLAB had the opportunity to showcase some of our developments and get to know those that other CoLABs and various National Innovation System entities also have to demonstrate.

There were also several presentations on innovation and some success stories, as well as discussing new perspectives and disruptive solutions in various panel discussions.

BUILT CoLAB was represented by João Moutinho, João Poças Martins, Vítor Cardoso, Vanessa Tavares and Pedro Ferreira.

TECH4INNOV is an ANI initiative whose main objective is to promote technology and knowledge transfer activities, boosting their valorization and commercialization, allowing for greater and better coordination between companies and the National Scientific and Technological System.
